query: select c.concept_name as answer from <SCHEMA>.drug_exposure de join <SCHEMA>.concept c on c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id join <SCHEMA>.person p on p.person_id = de.person_id where p.person_source_value = '73713' AND LOWER(de.route_source_value) = LOWER('nu') AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
mimiciii_gold_query: select prescriptions.drug from prescriptions where prescriptions.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 73713 ) and prescriptions.route = 'nu' and datetime(prescriptions.startdate,'start of month') = datetime(current_time,'start of month','-0 month') order by prescriptions.startdate desc limit 1

query: select v.visit_start_datetime as answer from <SCHEMA>.visit_occurrence v join <SCHEMA>.person p on p.person_id = v.person_id where p.person_source_value = '70234' AND v.visit_start_date >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND v.visit_start_date < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' ORDER BY v.visit_start_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
mimiciii_gold_query: select admissions.admittime from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 70234 and datetime(admissions.admittime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') order by admissions.admittime desc limit 1

query: with index_condition as (select co.person_id, min(co.condition_start_date) as index_date from <SCHEMA>.condition_occurrence co where 1=1 AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT 4180312 AS concept_id UNION SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM <SCHEMA>.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4180312) group by co.person_id) select 1.0 - avg(case when d.death_date <= ic.index_date + INTERVAL '1 year' then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as answer from index_condition ic left join <SCHEMA>.death d on d.person_id = ic.person_id where 1=1
mimiciii_gold_query: select sum( case when patients.dod is null then 1 when strftime('%j',patients.dod) - strftime('%j',t2.charttime) > 1 * 365 then 1 else 0 end ) * 100 / count(*) from ( select t1.subject_id, t1.charttime from ( select admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime from diagnoses_icd join admissions on diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id where diagnoses_icd.icd9_code = ( select d_icd_diagnoses.icd9_code from d_icd_diagnoses where d_icd_diagnoses.short_title = 'ch dvt/embl low ext nos' ) group by admissions.subject_id having min(diagnoses_icd.charttime) = diagnoses_icd.charttime ) as t1 where strftime('%j',current_time) - strftime('%j',t1.charttime) > 1 * 365 ) as t2 join patients on t2.subject_id = patients.subject_id

query: with index_condition as (select co.person_id, min(co.condition_start_date) as index_date from <SCHEMA>.condition_occurrence co where 1=1 AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT 37164654 AS concept_id UNION SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM <SCHEMA>.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 37164654) group by co.person_id) select 1.0 - avg(case when d.death_date <= ic.index_date + INTERVAL '4 year' then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as answer from index_condition ic left join <SCHEMA>.death d on d.person_id = ic.person_id where 1=1 and exists (select 1 from <SCHEMA>.drug_exposure de where de.person_id = ic.person_id and de.drug_exposure_start_date >= ic.index_date AND de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT 19136048 AS concept_id UNION SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM <SCHEMA>.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 19136048))
